title: Does Generative AI speak Nigerian-Pidgin?: Issues about Representativeness and Bias for Multilingualism in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation performance and text generation metrics (BLEU, ChrF++, BERTScore) of LLMs in zero-shot and few-shot settings across two different pidgin varieties (West African Pidgin English and Nigerian Pidgin) to measure representational disparity.
